import pytest

import flask


def test_categories_keyword():
    app = flask.Flask(__name__)
    app.secret_key = "k"
    with app.test_request_context():
        flask.flash("a", "error")
        flask.flash("b", "info")
        assert flask.get_flashed_messages(categories=["error"]) == ["a"]
    with app.test_request_context():
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            flask.get_flashed_messages(category_filter=["error"])

import flask


def test_get_flashed_errors():
    app = flask.Flask(__name__)
    app.secret_key = "k"
    with app.test_request_context():
        flask.flash("bad", "error")
        flask.flash("ok", "info")
        flask.flash("worse", "error")
        assert flask.get_flashed_errors() == ["bad", "worse"]
